opening.argument: The video centers on examining the breadth of Canadian bank fees, beginning with "The Truth About Canadian Bank Fees" and asking, "I just want to make sure I understand these fees." It identifies multiple fee categories, including "ATM, wirefees, overdraft, underdraft," while the on-screen message states that Canadians pay billions per year in bank fees and that it is time to update the system. Although Coinbase branding appears, the description expressly characterizes the material as "informational purposes only" and says it "does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument." No specific product, return claim, payment flow, or viewer condition is presented, and the material is described as informational rather than investment advice.
